programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide at Jenna kommer inn på rett spor igjen, men hun har forårsaket mer skade for sine nærmeste enn det som kan rettes opp med litt PR. Vil de tilgi henne, eller må hun ta i bruk drastiske midler?

programme.title: Awkward
programme.desc: Jenna og jentene er venner igjen og Jenna tror at hun er klar for å gjenoppta kjærlighetsaffæren med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håper at hvis hun retter opp sine feil ved å hjelpe Val med å få tilbake jobben sin, vil universet belønne henne med å sørge for at hun og Matty blir sammen igjen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna utfordres til å sette spørsmålstegn ved hvem hun vil være i denne episke sesongfinalen.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: En pinlig stund venter når vi tar en titt på de beste klippene fra 'Awkward' der skuespillerne selv kommenterer de morsomste replikkene, de saftigste forholdene og mye mer fra deres favorittepisoder av Awkward.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: Sisteårsrampestreker lager kaos mens Jennas forsett om å slutte å tenke på Matty blir satt på prøve når hun overhører en forstyrrende hemmelighet.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna forårsaker en ulykke på skolen som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvensene av konfrontasjonen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyter litt popularitet, sliter Matty med å bli holdt utenfor. Samtidig prøver Jake seg på den nye jenta, og Ally holder en sexleke-fest.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøkene er kommet ut. Jenna depper over stikkordet under hennes bilde, men hva kommer Matty til å skrive i årboken hennes?

programme.title: John Mellencamp MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This one-hour episode with beloved American rocker John Mellencamp was taped in Los Angeles in April of 1992, and features a medley of Mellencamp hits, past and present.

programme.title: Elton John MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In this MTV Unplugged Special, one of the most extravagant rockstars hits the stage. This is Elton John Unplugged.

programme.title: Nirvana MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Nirvana's classic acoustic performance recorded at Sony Music Studios in New York City on November 18, 1993.

programme.title: Lady Gaga & Tony Bennett MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This highly-anticipated episode of MTV Unplugged features Lady Gaga and Tony Bennett performing a combination of stripped-back duets and solo songs from their Grammy-nominated album, Love For Sale.

programme.title: Placebo MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In an intimate live performance, superstars demonstrate their skills with acoustic versions of their greatest hits. This episode features Placebo unplugged.

programme.title: The Roast of Alec Baldwin
programme.desc: Nå er det Alec Baldwins tur i den varme stolen, årets Roast Master er Sean Hayes, og blant de som roaster finner vi Robert De Niro, Caitlyn Jenner og Nikki Glaser.

programme.title: Another Period: Lillian's Wedding
programme.desc: Lillian vil gifte seg med en rik olding, Laverne. Gnistene flyr mellom Hortense og Lavernes kjekke barnebarn Bertram. Etter at avslørende bilder truer Fredericks stilling som visepresident, forviser han Beatrice fra Bellacourt Manor.

programme.title: Another Period: The Duel
programme.desc: Når Dodo mottar skilsmissepapirer, drar hun tilbake til Bellacourt for å ordne opp i sakene og utfordrer Chair til duell. Etter Lavernes død drukner Lillian sine sorger i alkohol, noe den nylig døpte Beatrice misliker sterkt.

programme.title: Another Period: Lillian is Dead
programme.desc: Hortense og Bertrams lykke viser seg å være kortlivet, så også Commodore og Chairs. Beatrice vender seg mot religionen når hennes slagsmål med Lillian får dødelige konsekvenser. Og nedenunder nedkommer Blanche med barn.

programme.title: Another Period: Roosevelt
programme.desc: Huset Commodore inviterer familien Roosevelt til Bellacourt Manor for å overbevise Teddy om å velge Frederick som visepresident. Lillian kaster blikket på FDR, Beatrice får en forbindelse med Eleanor. Peepers basker med en tjenerstreik.

programme.title: Detroiters: Pilot
programme.desc: Tim og Sam, to lavskala reklamemenn fra Detroit, prøver å få en stor kampanje med Chrysler, som ender i katastrofe. Ders assistent Lea påtar seg en badekar-reklame på egen hånd. Gjesteskuespiller Jason Sudeikis og Steve Higgins.

programme.title: Detroiters: Devereux Wigs
programme.desc: Tim og Sam forsøker å få en gammel Motown-legende til å synge en jingle i en reklame for et lokalt parykkfirma som de produserer, og Tim må forsone seg med sine sangferdigheter. Gjesteopptreden med George Wallace.

programme.title: Detroiters: Sam 'The Man'
programme.desc: Sam begynner å date en kvinne fra kommunestyret som tror han er prostituert. Tim og kona hans blir inspirert av Sams nye livsstil og prøver ut rollespill.

programme.title: Workaholics: Piss and S*t
programme.desc: Anders, Adam og Blake tenker kreativt når de må bestå en narkotest på jobben. De forsøker å bestikke mindre barn for å få rene urinprøver.

programme.title: Workaholics: The Promotion
programme.desc: Alice antyder at noen skal bli forfremmet på jobben. Anders, Adam og Blake føler at de fortjener en forfremmelse og konkurrerer om den.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Gitano

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Phantoms
programme.desc: To fight an aging dictator's purge of young artists, an IMF member (guest star Antoinette Bower) becomes a ghost and Paris assumes the guise of a man long dead on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 706
programme.desc: Mie og Jakob har flyttet inn hos Jakobs mor for å spare til drømmehuset. Men er drømmehuset i det hele tatt på markedet? Tobias argumenterer for sin sak, og Mie og Jakob får seg et sjokk.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 707

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 102
programme.desc: Vi besøker Jannie og René i leiligheten deres i sentrum av Esbjerg. Datteren Alba på 1 år sover på foreldrenes soverom, og har ikke et eget soverom.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 103
programme.desc: Sabine og Jakob leier en leilighet i Valby, der datteren Solveig sover i et lagringssrom på 4 kvadratmeter. Familien har et desperat behov for å flytte til noe større.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Merger of the Big Five, Part 3

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shreds of Evidence
programme.desc: Hairs and Fibers: The tiniest filament can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways. Investigators have come to rely on forensic evidence as fine as a carpet fiber or as innocent as an eyelash to crack difficult cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: My Teen Daughter Wants a Baby
programme.desc: 17-year-old Naomi has undergone a sudden attitude change and is on a mission to have a baby. Parents Leeanders and April need Steve to intervene!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Stole 15 Years of My Life
programme.desc: Jennifer left home to protect herself from her stepdad Allen. 15 years later, her mother wants a second chance, but Jennifer is hesitant. Can Steve help mend this broken family?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: She Is My Property
programme.desc: Lanikka is sick and tired of her boyfriend Malcom’s abusive ways. Then, Tim’s jealousy has torn his family apart, but now he’s desperate to win them back, but will Tiffany leave him for good?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Slept With THAT Man?
programme.desc: LaShawna and her boyfriend James will learn if her friend Coral harmed her child years ago. She’ll also admit that she cheated with Coral. How will he react when he finds out another bombshell?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Better Not Fail That Test!
programme.desc: Lainie and Justin have a 9-month-old baby together. Justin hurts Lainie because he thinks she’s cheating. But how will Steve react when he confronts Justin?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: How Could You Cover for Him?
programme.desc: Gina believes that her daughter’s boyfriend Efrain is abusing her grandson. Her daughter wants to prove that Efrain is innocent, but her father Raul suspects she is covering for Efrain.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who Did This?
programme.desc: Who’s responsible for toddler Noel's well-being? Everyone may deny the allegations, but someone knows what happened, and Steve is getting answers!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Human Animal
programme.desc: The naked body of a vibrant young mother is found frozen solid in a deserted cemetery. Kenda reopens the investigation and recognizes the sinister hallmark of a serial killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Trigger
programme.desc: A sharp-dressed pedestrian is shot in the back for unknown reasons. Chasing a promising lead, Kenda realizes he’s barking up the wrong tree.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Loose Cannon
programme.desc: In the dead of night, a shooter on a rampage rips through a home, leaving a grandmother disfigured, her 24 year old daughter dead, and a two year-old child clinging to life.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Grip
programme.desc: When a speeding truck crashes into a residential building, officers find the lifeless body of Michael Faast behind the wheel. But he didn’t die in the wreck – he was shot point-blank in the temple.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: After School Special
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes when a beloved teacher is poisoned in her classroom. As doctors fight to save Barbara Lewis’ life, Lt. Joe Kenda and his team delve into her personal affairs.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Cops: Pup and Rescue
programme.desc: A driver denies ownership of what police find in his car. Police conduct a narcotics sting that nets several arrests. A deputy removes a pooch from the scene of an accident.

programme.title: Cops: Undercover Blues
programme.desc: Police work a sting that targets drug dealers. An undercover sting uncovers narcotics trafficking. Police respond to a burglary in progress and discover a flop house.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer NO: Jesse Matthew
programme.desc: A taxi driver in Charlottesville who targeted young woman at university campuses. DNA linked an unknown perpetrator to an abduction, rape and attempted murder in 2005, and a rape and murder in 2009.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer NO: Stephen Port
programme.desc: Stephen Port preyed on young men though his grindr account, he spent hours searching web porn, a predator and he was to take the lives of four much-loved young men.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer NO: William Howell
programme.desc: William Devin Howell kept a secret for 14 years; when a string of women went missing from towns near this Highway in Connecticut, he was responsible. As the opioid-addicted women became frantic for their next hit, they'd turned to selling sex.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer NO: James Fairweather
programme.desc: James Fairweather is no ordinary teenager in 2014. Most his age don't choose the dark, violent games and websites that James does as he returns from school, retreats behind the bedroom door.

programme.desc: Jake og Chase er dypt inne i en hule når Jake klarer å sette fast ankelen mellom noen steiner // Adventure Bukta's Paradedag går galt når Alex fester for mange ballonger på badekar-flåten til Katie. Den bokstavelig talt 'flyter' bort!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Ordfører-konkurransen / Valpene Redder Tyvegodset
programme.desc: Det er det årlige ordfører-racet og Ordfører Humdinger legger planer for den verste juksingen noensinne // Når Ryder kommer over et gammelt skattekart, stjeler Ordfører Humdinger kartet for å finne skatten selv.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Grynterne / Valpene og Spøkelseshytta
programme.desc: En sykedag hos Paw Patrol? Mens Rubbel og Ryder leter etter grisene til Al, må Marshall passe på de snufsete valpene // Først forsvinner lunchen til Rubbel, så er lunch-boksen til Jake borte. Er det et spøkelse?

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Bjeffer med Dinosaurer
programme.desc: Valpene er på en utgraving når de graver ut tre fossile egg. Plutselig begynner eggene å klekke og snart er det tre pterodactyler som løper rundt i Adventure Bukta. Nå er det opp til Paw Patrol å fange dinosaurene.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder et Spøkelse / Valpene Redder en Forestilling
programme.desc: Et mystisk spøkelse forårsaker kaos om natten. Valpene og Chase sitter på vakt for å fange det, men oppdager at det ikke er et spøkelse i det hele tatt. // Valpene skal sette opp på et Middelalderskuespill i bytorget, men så kollapser scenen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Flyndra og Francois / Valpene Redder Pingvinene
programme.desc: Cap'n Turbot og Francois er ute og ser etter hvaler når Flyndra treffer en stein og begynner å synke. Denne redningsaksjonen krever alle labber på dekk. // Pop-up pingviner er plassert over hele Adventure Bukta. På tide å ringe Paw Patrol!

programme.desc: Jake og Everest gleder seg til snøbrett-konkurransen inntil de ser at hele løypa er dekket av snø. // Når Paw Patrol drar for å finne dykkerklokken til Cap'n Turbot som har sunket, møter de en gigantisk sjøsnegle.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Speidertur / Valpene Redder en Overraskelse
programme.desc: Marshall og Paw Patrol hjelper Alex med å lære om brannsikkerhet mens de er på campingtur. // Det ser ut til å være en vanlig dag i Adventure Bukta når Paw Patrol blir kalt ut på et oppdrag. Men Valpene får seg litt av en overraskelse!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Godsakene / Valpene og Stolheisen
programme.desc: Herr Porters bil full av valpemat og godsaker glir på isen, og Ryder og Paw Patrol må redde den. // Ryder og Paw Patrol må redde Katie og Cali når de blir sittende fast i stolheisen på Jake-fjellet.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Teltturen / Valpene og Skilpaddene
programme.desc: Skye og Rocky skal på sin første telttur, men når Chickaletta faller ned i en sprekk, må de tilkalle resten av Paw Patrol. // Ryder og valpene må hjelpe en gjeng babyskilpadder å finne tilbake til dammen sin.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Påskeegg-jakten
programme.desc: Det er den årlige påskeegg-jakten og valpene hjelper ordfører Goodway med å male eggene. Jakten på et helt spesielt egg leder Ryder og Paw Patrol ut på et spennende eventyr.

programme.title: Men Alle Vet

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris Wilton er en ung og vakker men fattig tennistrener som involveres i en rik familie gjennom å trene en av familiemedlemmene. Kjærlighetsaffærer med to kvinner samtidig tvinger ham til å begå en alvorlig forbrytelse.

programme.title: The Female Brain

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding

programme.title: Midnight in Paris
programme.desc: Paris om morgenen er vakker. Paris om ettermiddagen er sjarmerende. Paris om kvelden er fortryllende. Men - Paris etter midnatt er magisk!

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: En kvinne reiser langrenn til California for å være sammen med sønnen etter at han bestemmer seg for å droppe skolen og bli surfer.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Bitch is Back
programme.desc: Laila gjemmer seg, ute av stand til å tilbringe natten alene. Vanessa kjøper motvillig en ny mobil til Laila, og får snart vite at Susie Q er død. Vanessa tvinges til å trøste henne tross at hun ikke holder henne ut.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Way You Save

programme.title: Boomerang: Don't Wanna Love You

programme.title: Boomerang: Reversal Of a Dog

programme.title: Boomerang: Day Weekend
programme.desc: Simone samler gjengen og særskilte andre på farens luksusstrandhus. Det skulle føre alle sammen, men slutter med å vise hvordan alle har forandret seg og muligens vokst fra hverandre.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mary Jane Knows Best

programme.desc: Kara vil beskytte Mary Jane fra resultatet av en fokusgruppe, Niecy prøver å verne seg seg og Treyvion for faren hans, som uventet dukker opp fra college. Patrick prøver å balansere arbeid og familie, og Mary Jane treffer Sheldon.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 503

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 504
programme.desc: Louisas hippiemor, Eleanor, ankommer byen og overtar umiddelbart Martins kjøkken for å lage et urtetonic, som hun gir til barnet for å få ham til å slutte å gråte.

programme.desc: PC Penhale er sjokkert over den uventede ankomsten av sin ekskone Maggie, som ser ut til å ha glemt at de skilte seg for flere år siden, og vil vite hvorfor han gikk fra henne.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 506
programme.desc: Maggie får klarsignal fra legen og bestemmer seg for at hun skal tilbake til Bude, noe som tvinger PC Penhale til å ty til desperate tiltak for å overtale henne til å bli i Portwenn.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 507
programme.desc: Bert Large restaurantvirksomhet er i økonomiske problemer. Han har ikke engang råd til mat og drikke til et veldedighetsarrangement for å samle inn penger til Florence Dingles kattereservat.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Uforenlige likheter
programme.desc: Billy og Amandas samliv trues av krangler som følge av deres ulike smaker: Billy er praktisk, mens Amanda er havesyk.

programme.desc: Når Billys far plutselig dør av et massivt hjerteinfarkt, forsøker storesøsteren hans å overbevise ham om at faren faktisk elsket ham.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Testen
programme.desc: Når en ekskjæreste besøker Jake for å fortelle ham at hun har AIDS, får Jake panikk, og han informerer Jo så de begge kan teste seg.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Presse grensene
programme.desc: Billy blir forfremmet i bladet og tror sjefen er ute etter å ta ham. I mellomtiden gjør Amanda livet surt for Alison.

programme.desc: Kris' endeavors to get accustomed to her new relationship with Matt and deal with Pablo's departure are interrupted by a surprise visit from her half brother (Ignacio Serricchio).

programme.desc: Charity, en ambisiøs journalist, lærer hva julen egentlig handler om mens hun undersøker Erik Gallagher, en millionær som insisterer på at julenissen kommer med gaver hvert år.

programme.desc: En forfatter samler sammen familie og venner for å redde en elsket by før jul, og finner kjærligheten underveis.

programme.desc: En hardtarbeidende mor tar med seg barna på en utfordrende roadtrip etter mannens svik.

programme.desc: Amber er nylig separert og mindre av alt. Fast bestemt på at dette er nok, bestemmer hun seg for å finne noe som kan gjøre henne glad igjen.

programme.title: Scorpion: Strife on Mars

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When Don and his team investigate a murder at a horse track, they stumble onto more than just a plot of betting on fixed races. Aya Sumika ("The O.C.") begins her recurring role as agent Liz Warner, Don's former trainee.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When a series of blackouts occur in power stations leaving Los Angeles in the dark, Don and his team must determine if it is an accident or the work of terrorists.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and his team investigate the death of a minor league baseball player to determine if it was an accidental overdose of steroids or a homicide.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and his team investigate a trail of illegal waste disposal after a sinkhole, which collapses in a school playground, kills an elderly woman and injures several children. Kathy Najimy joins the cast in a recurring role as Charlie's new boss.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: During the murder investigation of a state senator, Don and his team discover a plot to exact revenge on the individuals involved in a government sponsored behavior modification project.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and Charlie try to catch a serial killer who is seeking revenge against internet sexual predators who prey on young girls they meet in chat rooms. Apollo 11 Astronaut Buzz Aldrin guest-stars as himself.

programme.title: The American Friend aka Der Amerikanische Freund

programme.title: Only God Forgives
programme.desc: Julian er en narkosmugler som har fremgang i Bangkoks kriminelle underverden. Hans liv blir enda mer komplisert da moren tvinger ham til å finne og drepe den ansvarlige for brorens nylige dødsfall.

programme.title: Wagons East
programme.desc: De var ute etter gull, men nå tar de til takke med innlagt vann. John Candy og Richard Lewis spiller i dette hysterisk ukonvensjonelle blikket på den legendariske ville vesten.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Sam synker dypt når han forsøker å kjøpe sin gamle bil tilbake.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Frasiers unge sekretær drar på date med ham for å hevne seg på foreldrene.

programme.title: Cheers

programme.desc: With eight chefs left in the team challenge, the red and blue team are each responsible for creating five different burgers: beef, chicken, lamb, salmon and turkey.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Pest
programme.desc: Walker må redde livet til sine venner på Cherokee-reservatet når de settes i fare av et selskap som driver et eksperimentelt meieri og velger fremtidig profitt fremfor sikkerhet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Forløsning
programme.desc: Det er Cahill mot Cahill når sjefen for en forbryterliga hyrer Alex sin alkoholiserte far, Gordon Cahill, som forsvarsadvokat.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Kodenavn: Dragonfly
programme.desc: Walkers nemesis fra Vietnam-tiden stjeler et hemmelig militærhelikopter for å smugle dop for kartellene, og Walker får sjansen til å rydde opp i gatene og gjøre opp for fortiden.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Et stille rop
programme.desc: Darcy Reynolds, datteren til Walkers venn, voldtas etter at drinken hennes blir dopet på 21-årsdagen hennes. Walker leter etter overfallsmennene på nattklubbene i Dallas.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Svanesang
programme.desc: Når et styrtet fly som ble brukt i et bankran og drapet på Walkers venn åtte år tidligere oppdages i Utahs fjell, drar Walker dit for å prøve å løse saken.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Syklon
programme.desc: Alex og C.D. følger en gruppe barn hjem etter "Barn i regjeringen" når de tas som gisler av kidnappere som begraver bussen deres i gjørme, og Walker må redde dem før en syklon når dem.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Phantoms
programme.desc: To fight an aging dictator's purge of young artists, an IMF member (guest star Antoinette Bower) becomes a ghost and Paris assumes the guise of a man long dead on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Lover's Knot
programme.desc: In the midst of delicate operations to identify the chief of an espionage ring, Jim Phelps realizes that Paris has fallen in love with an enemy agent on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Orpheus
programme.desc: Jim Phelps assumes a risky pose as a drug addict with information to sell to get behind the Iron Curtain where he seeks to stop an unknown assassin from killing an unknown victim on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Choice
programme.desc: Paris is marked for execution when he impersonates a power-mad mystic trying to win control of a friendly country by hypnotizing its woman ruler on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Crane
programme.desc: After rescuing a prisoner from execution by a dictator (guest star Carl Betz), the IMF has to find a hiding place so conspicuous it will be overlooked by police hunting the fugitive on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 103
programme.desc: Sabine og Jakob leier en leilighet i Valby, der datteren Solveig sover i et lagringssrom på 4 kvadratmeter. Familien har et desperat behov for å flytte til noe større.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 104
programme.desc: Sonja og Emil bor sammen med sønnen Vilmer på 1 år i en leilighet på Nørrebro. De har pusset opp hele leiligheten selv, og det var så slitsomt at de ikke orker tanken på å gjøre det igjen.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 105
programme.desc: Programleder Lisbeth Østergaard og de to ekspertene besøker Charlotte og Martin, som drømmer om å starte på ny frisk og flytte inn i et hus der de kan starte en familie.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 201
programme.desc: Programleder Camilla Ottesen, eiendomsmegler Tobias Edlev Nielsen og arkitekt Mads Kappel Mikkelsen besøker Ida og Aske på Østerbro. De har vært på jakt etter bolig i et år, men har ikke funnet drømmehjemmet.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 202
programme.desc: Eiendomsmegleren Tobias og arkitekten Mads får en vanskelig oppgave, når de skal finne et hus til Lea og Sebastian fra Brønshøj.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Back to Battle City, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi and friends arrive at KaibaCorp Island where the Battle City finalists will compete in the ultimate dueling arena! Get ready for the awesome four-person battle royal where any duelist can attack anyone else!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Back to Battle City, Part 2
programme.desc: Honor, friendship, revenge... As each duelist remembers what they're fighting for, the battle royal rages on where none of the duelists know where the next attack is going to come from!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Back to Battle City, Part 3
programme.desc: Joey may have fought some of the fiercest fights in Battle City, but has all his training taught him to become an elite duelist? Joey's gonna show what he's made of in the conclusion to the four-man battle royal!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Darkness Returns, Part 1
programme.desc: Marik ensnares Joey in a Shadow Game where each duelist's heart is linked with his monsters... literally! Every time a monster received damage, the duelist feels the pain instead!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Darkness Returns, Part 2
programme.desc: Marik's Helpoemer send Joey's powerful cards to the graveyard before Joey can use them! Running low on cards and life points, Joey's opportunities for staging a comeback are nearly depleted!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Darkness Returns, Part 3
programme.desc: Joey thinks this duel can't turn any worse... but Marik has all the pieces necessary to summon The Winged Dragon of Ra! Can Joey prevent Marik from summoning the Egyptian God Card, or is victory simply not in the cards?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Darkness Returns, Part 4
programme.desc: Marik transforms The Winged Dragon of Ra into its powerful form, the Egyptian God Phoenix! If Joey can't withstand the Phoenix's blazing fire, he'll lose the duel... plus his only chance to save Mai from her mental prison!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Clash in the Coliseum, Part 1
programme.desc: It's the rematch we've all been waiting for! Yugi and Kaiba square off for the first time since Duelist Kingdom in front of thousands of ravenous fans for the right to challenge Marik! It's time to duel!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Clash in the Coliseum, Part 2
programme.desc: Kaiba has all the monsters necessary to summon Obelisk the Tormentor to finish Yugi off! Though overwhelmed and outmatched, nothing is going to stop Yugi from trying to summon his Egyptian God first!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Clash in the Coliseum, Part 3
programme.desc: When Yugi's Slifer the Sky Dragon clashes against Kaiba's Obelisk the Tormentor, what will happen when two Egyptian Gods fight each other? It's time to find out which Egyptian God is truly stronger!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Clash in the Coliseum, Part 4
programme.desc: The clash of the two Egyptian God Monsters releases mystical energies that show Yugi and Kaiba visions of the ancient Egyptian past! What new answers do these images unlock, and what prophecies do they make for the future?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Conflicting Feelings

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Scott's Up To Something

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Another Newbie Gets Cut

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Friends Again
programme.desc: Marty drikker seg dritings og får lyst på eksen sin. Vil Chloe like det? Sjefen Anna har en overraskelse på lur til nykommerne. Zahida prøver å få snakket ut med Sarah og Abbie, men det gjør ting bare verre.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Welcome To The Family
programme.desc: Geordiene arrangerer en stor bursdagsfest for Nathan, med en helt spesiell kake. Sjefen Anna må bestemme hvem som skal få bli i huset - Abbie, Sarah eller Zahida? Sesongens siste episode.

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The Raimon Vs Raimon Face Off!

programme.title: Inazuma Eleven: The World’s Strongest Team: Fire Version!

programme.desc: After Australia, next rivals are here: players used to run and with a lot of stamina. Inazuma National should reinforce those features within the team. Or they should, as soon as they discover why one of them is always leaving training early.

programme.title: JAG: The Boast

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brotherhood of Hate
programme.desc: In 1984, a tragic murder led agents into the frightening world of domestic terrorism. Law enforcement vowed to dismantle the violent faction that claimed responsibility.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Who Did This?
programme.desc: Who’s responsible for toddler Noel's well-being? Everyone may deny the allegations, but someone knows what happened, and Steve is getting answers!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: My Boyfriend Beat Up My Mom
programme.desc: Kendra is on a mission to save herself from her toxic boyfriend Chris. At 17, Kendra is pregnant with his sixth child. Kendra has tried almost everything including kicking him out of their house, but he not only argued back but assaulted Kendra as well.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Over the Edge
programme.desc: Sheroya is 17 and struggling to raise 2 kids while trying to party all the time. Her boyfriend Malcolm frequently cheats and verbally abuses her. Steve’s got a lot of work ahead with this couple, but will either of them wake up?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Failed 5 Times?
programme.desc: Did Everett touch his girlfriend Michelle’s daughter? Her ex Robert says that his 7-year-old daughter said so. Everett will take a lie detector test to disprove it! Don’t miss these shocking results!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I’m Not the Man You Think I Am
programme.desc: Sean says his wife has made him so angry that he’s put her in the hospital over 10 times. Sean’s also got a secret of his own — he is really a she! Can Steve help Sean iron out his issues?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Real Teens: Real Topics
programme.desc: Steve’s hosting another teen girl town hall to address critical issues all teen girls could face, including drug use, physical abuse, and online predators. No question is off limits!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: 12 Years a Fugitive
programme.desc: When a beloved grandmother is found stabbed to death in her own home, Kenda must turn to a tight-knit community still grieving from the tragic loss.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Poker Face
programme.desc: A group of friends discover the corpse of entrepreneur Jamie Foster hidden under a blanket. Kenda e discovers that Foster’s business put him in close quarters with a host of unsavory characters.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Uninvited Guest
programme.desc: A soldier is stabbed to death at a drive-thru. Kenda’s only clue is that this is somehow tied to a breakdancing competition.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Who Took Heather?
programme.desc: A 13-year-old girl is missing, sending Kenda’s city into a panic. A cryptic letter to the District Attorney’s office suggests the girl isn’t the only victim.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Blood
programme.desc: A army vet is found bleeding to death on the asphalt of a parking lot -- his chest littered with too many knife wounds to count. Kenda’s case is stuck in first gear until a gruesome clue appears.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rays
programme.desc: Cosmic rays can tell us much about the universe. They are not simply another form of light, but carriers of information about powerful and unseen processes at work thousands or even millions of light years away.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: The Truth is in the Stars
programme.desc: Does our society have the capacity to live up to Star Trek's optimistic vision for humanity's future? William Shatner takes us on a journey to find out whether art has imitated life in the years since the world-renowned TV series premiered in 1966.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer NO: James Fairweather
programme.desc: James Fairweather is no ordinary teenager in 2014. Most his age don't choose the dark, violent games and websites that James does as he returns from school, retreats behind the bedroom door.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer NO: Mark Martin
programme.desc: Mark Martin made no secret of the fact that when he grew up he wanted to be a serial Killer. The Krays, Donald Neilson, Ian Brady all serial killers, were his childhood heroes.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer NO: Shawn Grate
programme.desc: Shawn was a good looking boy, and he learnt that he could turn on a smile and get what he wanted. He was popular with women but often in trouble for abusing them. He was sent to prison at 22 for choking his pregnant girlfriend.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer NO: Donna Perry
programme.desc: In Spokane three prostitutes were violently killed. Evidence suggested they'd been approached by a man wanting sex who had then used great strength to subdue and kill them. They had the suspects DNA, but detectives had no idea who the killer was.

programme.title: Crime Down Under: Undercover: Going Under
programme.desc: The official undercover program is launched in the 1970s, as agents begin the war against drugs and take on the might of the Mr Asia crime ring.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare på Dobbel Date

programme.desc: Ryder og Paw Patrol må hjelpe Alex ut av knipa han forårsaker på Jake-fjellet. // Paw Patrol må finne ut hva slags snømonster som skremmer skiløperne på Jake-fjellet.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder Julen
programme.desc: Når Nissen slede krasjer og reinsdyrene rømmer, må Ryder og Paw Patrol hjelpe Nissen med å dele ut presanger og redde julen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene og bønnestengelen / Valpene redder Turbot-fetterne
programme.desc: Rubble vil ta en lur under et tre, når Adventure-bukta plutselig får et stort problem-kjempen Alex. // Cap'n Turbot trenger et bilde av en sjelden fugl, og fetteren bestemmer seg for å hjelpe ham, men blir sittende fast på en klippe.

programme.desc: Rubble later som han er superhvalp, men havner i trøbbel og må få hjelp av Ryder og Paw Patrol. // Ryders robotvalp går i stykker og lager kaos i Adventure-bukta, og Paw Patrol må hjelpe Ryder med å finne den.

programme.desc: Ryder og Paw Patrol må redde Alex når han tar av på den nye super-trehjulingen sin. // Marshall viser seg om en ekte helt når han slukker en ekte brann.

programme.desc: Det er en varm dag og valpene har lyst til å bade, men bassenget er tomt for vann. Paw Patrol må fylle vann i bassenget. // Ryder og Paw Patrol må steppe inn som sirkusartister når dyrene ikke kommer frem i tide.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Flaggermus / Valpene Redder en Tann
programme.desc: Ryder og Paw Patrol må hjelpe en flaggermus som har kommet bort fra flokken sin og sovnet i rådhusklokka. // Chase og Alex er redde for å gå til tannlegen, og Ryder og de andre valpene må hjelpe dem å overvinne tannlegeskrekken.

programme.desc: Ryder og Paw Patrol må fange en ape som rømmer fra buret sitt i togvognen. // Ryder og Paw Patrol redder en liten ugle og gjenforener den med moren sin.

programme.title: iCarly: Møtet med førstedamen

programme.title: iCarly: Billetten

programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt disset i et intervju om iCarly, prøver Freddie å vise sin kreative side gjennom å webb-sende iCarly i 3D. Spencer ansetter en assistent som han ikke har råd til å betale.

programme.title: iCarly: Tabber
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skuespilleren som spiller Rex on Victorious, venner tilbake som vert i et dyptgående intervju med stjernerne fra iCarly og viser deres supergøyale tabber og bortklipte scener. Gjestestjerne: Rex fra Victorious

programme.title: iCarly: Fortsatt like gal
programme.desc: Ettr å ha fått beskjed om at Nora Dershlit blir løslatt fra fengselet, ser iCarly-gjengen på hva de kan gjøre for å holde sin gamle kidnapper bak lås og slå. Imens oppdager Freddies mor den virkelige T-Bo.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly møter One Direction
programme.desc: Carly får en smittsom sykdom og kommer til å smitte et medlem i bandet One Direction. I mens skal Spencer trene en liten jente som ikke kan fordra å morsjonere.

programme.desc: Gibby åpner en hemmelig restaurant i skolens kjeller med Sams hjelp. Og Spencer designer en sikkerhetsrobot til hjemmebruk, som plutselig mister fokus helt.

programme.title: iCarly: Aprilsnarr
programme.desc: I dette spesielle aprilsnarr-avsnittet blir Carly og Spencer satt på gaten, så gjengen sitter og tenker tilbake på sin tid i Bushwell Plaza. Men minnene deres stemmer kanskje ikke alltid helt med hvordan vi husker hendelsene.

programme.title: iCarly: Dårlig stemning i butikken
programme.desc: Freddies nye drømmejobb i Pear Store blir et mareritt når Sam også blir ansatt. Imens prøver Carly å bli inviteret ut av en fra Pear Store, og Spencer må melde seg til frivillig jobb på den lokale brannstasjonen.

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna avslører hva som hendte med henne og resten av gjengen i året som gikk - hva som var grunnen til isen som la seg mellom Matty og Jenna, hva som varmet forholdet mellom Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa gjenfant romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna unngår et nytt forhold for å få kontakt med dem hun jobber sammen med. I mens holder Tamara et chict bursdagsselskap for Sadie - som etterlater mer enn en festdeltager i slett festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøk på å gjøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for henne selv, spleiser Jenna Tamara med en praktikant, men oppdager raskt at å jobbe med venner raskt kan bli en katastrofe.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake sikrer Jenna og Tamara skift på country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en etterfest på golfbanen resulterer i dramatiske fyrverkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Etter moroa på 4. juli, fortsetter Jenna og Matty å fyre opp under vennskapet ved å holde fest for Jake - i det minste inntil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med å avsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver å velge mellom suksess hos Idea Bin og sitt vennskap med Matty. Jake opplever et uventet intimt møte, og Sadie og Sergio driver plutselig og sparrer mer enn noen gang.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder seg som barnevakt og mottar uventet hjelp av Matty. I mens får Lissa vite hva som er hemmeligheten ved å være en Palos Hills-mamma, og Tamara og Sadie får mer en nok på en rik tenårings strandselskap.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tar forholdet med Luke ett nivå opp og Tamaras gjeld kommer tilbake og biter henne i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: En krangel med Luke presser Jenna til å bli med på leirgjenforeningen og dermed mot å gjenoppta kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjelper Jenna til å få et viktig møte på SCU, Tamara er ærlig mot Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjelp til å komme inn igjen i varmen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må velge mellom et viktig SCU-event og leirgjenforeningen, noe som fører til et enda større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må ta avgjørende valg de også.

programme.title: Paul McCartney MTV Unplugged

programme.title: John Mellencamp MTV Unplugged

programme.title: Elton John MTV Unplugged

programme.title: Nirvana MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Nirvana's classic acoustic performance recorded at Sony Music Studios in New York City on November 18, 1993.

programme.title: Lady Gaga & Tony Bennett MTV Unplugged

programme.title: Placebo MTV Unplugged

programme.title: RENO 911!: Execution Tickets
programme.desc: The deputies partake in a scavenger hunt to determine who gets to attend the execution of a convicted felon, and Williams gives a suspect a makeover.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine's Pregnant
programme.desc: A mandatory staff drug test reveals a surprise pregnancy, and Lt. Dangle has a brush with a celebrity.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Liverpool's Secret Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Bex and Sean delve deep into Woolton Hall, a derelict mansion in Liverpool. They appear to be forced out of the building by an unknown force and it takes its toll on one of the team members.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mill, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Mill – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Weir Mill and the search for paranormal activity takes a darker turn. Will they finally uncover the truth behind the buildings dark hauntings?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Spirits at The Lord Eldon
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team travels to the old town of Knutsford, Cheshire to investigate the historic Lord Eldon Inn, hoping to contact the spirit of Sarah Ann Pollitt who is said to haunt the pub.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Lost Souls of One Melling Road
programme.desc: The team heads to Liverpool to help a restaurant uncover what could be haunting there. Bex and Sean encounter the spirit of a white lady in the private quarters.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Jack The Ripper
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to Sefton and investigate a police station connected to the murderous Jack The Ripper. Was James Maybrick really the Ripper? Did his wife poison him?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1732
programme.desc: Liam og Nina prøver desperat å få tid alene. Stian kjenner på sjalusi. Er vennskapene i paradiset så sterke som deltakerne påstår, eller ligger et bedrag rett rundt hjørnet?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1733
programme.desc: Juryen har tatt sin avgjørelse, og en gutt sendes ut av hotellet. Jentene får et vanskelig valg som kan avgjøre skjebnen til en av guttene. Det går hett for seg på sesongens siste Pandoras.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1734
programme.desc: Alle frykter å stå mot juryens favoritter i en finale. Det blir høy temperatur på hjerteknuserseremonien.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1735
programme.desc: Det er klart for siste fest med en meget bitter jury. Alt gammelt "gnag" skal frem i lyset. Vil finaleparenes planer for å sanke stemmer virke?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!: Episode 1736
programme.desc: Det er FINALE på Paradise Hotel! Og den skal vise seg å bli mer nervepirrende enn noen av gjestene kunne sett for seg.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Norge - Ny sesong!
programme.desc: Ett år etter innspillingen møtes hotellgjestene igjen for å snakke ut om allianser, svik, intriger og romanser. Det blir en intens gjenforening, med sterke følelser og uforløste konflikter.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1002
programme.desc: Lise og Damien blir snart tobarnsforeldre og vil ut av bykjernen og ned på bakkeplan. Cecilia starter i ny jobb i Trondheim om to uker, men har ikke hatt tid til å gå på visninger.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1003
programme.desc: Ole Jørgen og Gina er førstegangskjøpere på begrenset budsjett, og drømmer om en fredfull og landlig enebolig til seg og kattene. Oda og Simon har noen spesielle utfordringer med sin nåværende bolig.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1004
programme.desc: Alenemoren Ragnhild og sønnen Julius sover i dag i køyeseng, og trenger desperat større plass. Christina og amerikanske Justin har mange krav på lista, og Karianne tar utfordringa på strak arm!

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1005
programme.desc: Samboerne Linn og Joakim bor i dag i drømmehuset, men det ligger på helt feil sted! Hans Christian møter Christine, som leter etter en ny leilighet med uteområde til katten sin.

programme.title: Boligjakten: Episode 1006
programme.desc: Christian skal selge leiligheten han har arvet, og Karianne får derfor en helt ny utfordring! Vi møter også tidligere deltagere og får bli med inn i deres nye leiligheter, hus og gårdsbruk.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 532
programme.desc: Det er kun tre deltakere igjen på Camp Kulinaris. To krevende konkurranser står mellom dem, og en plass i selve finalen.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 533
programme.desc: Finaledagen har kommet. Utfordringene står i kø når de to finalistene skal lage hver sin treretters meny. Den som serverer det beste måltidet i dag, står igjen som vinneren av Camp Kulinaris 2022.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 601
programme.desc: 10 nye kjendiser flytter inn på Camp Kulinaris. Her skal de bo sammen mens de drifter sin egen restaurant i regi av mesterkokk Kjartan Skjelde.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 602
programme.desc: Gjengen er i gang på kjøkkenet og allerede i starten gjør litermål matlagingen vanskelig for Raylee. Samtidig viser det seg at kombinasjonen Mutta og flammer er en dårlig idé.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Episode 603
programme.desc: Det er sesongens første servering på Camp Kulinaris. Det blir tårevått for Ellen når desserten skal serveres til Kjartan. Klarer gruppen å få sin første godkjente servering.

programme.title: Charterfeber
programme.desc: Charter-Svein er tilbake, og med seg på lasset har han sine tre like energiske barn Noah, Liam og Ylva. Roger drar til havs for å fiske hai og har en opplevelsesrik tur på sjøen.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1304
programme.desc: Buskeruddamene har landet og er klare for irish og strawberry. De må bare få permobil-lappen først. Det er onkel Erlings drømmedag og han har planlagt aktiviteter for gjengen de sikkert vil elske.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1305
programme.desc: Haider tar gladelig på seg rollen som Baywatch-stjerne da familien trenger opplæring i livredning. Rockeren Geir vil gjengjelde Fred Åges godhet og har planlagt en dag full av gaver og overraskelser.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1306
programme.desc: På Gran Canaria tar kjærligheten, vennskapet og små hverdagsdramaer uventede vendinger. Haider håper på en romantisk date med Neelam, Pondern og Mutza sliter med å mestre en nøkkelboks.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1307
programme.desc: Roger våkner etter mareritt og må vaske klær etter noen hete og svette dager på øya. Pondern og Mutza setter i gang fyllestream med utfordringer, og Buskerud-gjengen legger ut på delfinsafari.

programme.title: Charterfeber: Episode 1301
programme.desc: Roger er tilbake på Gran Canaria etter en litt strevsom tur, og på hotellrommet oppstår det problemer med lysbryteren i år igjen. Familien Haider gjør comeback, men får en slitsom ankomst.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 410
programme.desc: I sesongens siste episode reiser gutta til Harstad for å pusse opp ei hytte for Den Norske Turistforening. Dugnadsånden henger høyt i dette svært spesielle prosjektet, som foregår over mange uker.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing
programme.desc: Høyt oppe på fjellet i Folldal ligger den gamle Reinslia Taubanestasjon. Her står det «inkamønster» på planen og det blir en fest med materialer og farger. Gutta får bryne seg på å lage skigard.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 106
programme.desc: Interiørdesigner Halvor drar på tur til Oppdal, med de nevedyktige kameratene Mikkel, Gustav og Thomas, for å pusse opp en hytte liggende praktfult til på Våttahaugen.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 806
programme.desc: Med utsikt over Vågå ligger årets vinterhytte. En typisk 80-talls furuhytte skal tilpasses den yngre generasjonen og gutta tar utfordringen på strak arm. Halvor viser hvordan man kan gjenbruke gamle vinduer, og hjemmesnekrede møbler får nytt liv.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 307
programme.desc: I Tydal finnes kanskje Norges yngste hytteeier, hun er 19 år! Guttas oppdrag blir derfor å lage en feminin, ungdommelig hytte som passer en ung kvinne og hennes venninner.

programme.title: Eventyrlig oppussing: Episode 309
programme.desc: Oppussingskvartetten dra til nydelige Kinn i Sogn og fjordane, hvor et fiskevær skal få en ny drakt. til nydelige Kinn i Sogn og fjordane, hvor et fiskevær skal få en ny drakt.

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2503
programme.desc: Livet til Odin ble snudd opp ned etter han ble alvorlig syk og gjelden fra før og under den livstruende kreftsykdommen stikker kjepper i hjulene for han.

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2504
programme.desc: Begjæring om tvangssalg ligger i postkassen til Sverre, og han bruker regninger til å fyre i peisen med. Sverre har valgt å gå på byen i stedenfor å ferdigstille huset som han nå står i fare for å miste.

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2505
programme.desc: Daniel drikker 3 liter cola om dagen og gamle forbrukslån står i veien for at han og Mona kan etablere seg. Det Mona tror er uskyldig tipping viser seg å være ganske mye mer omfattende.

programme.title: Luksusfellen: Episode 2506
programme.desc: Ulrik har tatt opp store forbrukslån for å etablere seg med familie. Lånene er ute av kontroll og han får en ubehagelig overraskelse når ekspertene ankommer. Ulrik har også en hemmelighet som avsløres.

programme.title: Luksusfellen
programme.desc: Madeleine elsker interiør, og klesskapet hennes bugner av nyinnkjøpte klær. Når Madeleine vil ha noe nytt så kjøper hun det. Hun lever over evne, og de dyre forbrukslånene hennes hoper seg opp.

programme.title: Luksusfellen
programme.desc: Robin kaster bort alle pengene på dyre hobbyer. Det har akkurat blitt slutt med Madeleine fra forrige episode, og med sin skyhøye gjeld og heftige forbruk er den nye hverdagen vanskelig.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Drakelow Tunnels
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Vow of Silence and Cryptic

programme.title: My Haunted House: Family Grave and Deception

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Attic and 'Til Death
programme.desc: A college student is tormented by her little sister's imaginary friend. A newly engaged woman sees visions of her fiance's widow.

programme.title: South Park: Heia Gud XII

programme.title: South Park: Julesnø

programme.title: South Park: Obama vinner!
programme.desc: Eric Cartman skjuler noe på soverommet sitt som kan endre hele utfallet av presidentvalget.

programme.title: South Park: Den røde manns griskhet

programme.title: South Park: Back to the Cold War

programme.title: South Park: Britneys nye stil
programme.desc: Mediesirkuset kommer til South Park når Britney gjemmer seg i den avsidesliggende fjellbyen. Guttene prøver å hjelpe den plagede popstjernen.

programme.title: South Park: Hvalhorer
programme.desc: Kyle blir med i en gruppe som lager en dokumentar som konfronterer japanske hvalfangere, men taktikken deres er langt fra imponerende.

programme.title: South Park: DikinBaus Hot Dogs

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 227
